subject: general
question: In which year was Smart Cities Mission launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2015**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Smart Cities Mission was launched by the Government of India in **2015**.
 
• The initiative aims to promote sustainable and inclusive cities that provide core infrastructure and give a decent quality of life to their citizens.
 
• It focuses on sustainable and inclusive development by creating replicable models which act like lighthouses to other aspiring cities.
 
• The mission targets the development of smart solutions that leverage digital and information technologies, urban planning best practices, public-private partnerships, and policy changes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Smart Cities Mission**

 
 
• It is an urban renewal and retrofitting program by the Government of India with the mission to develop smart cities across the country, making them citizen-friendly and sustainable.
 
• The Smart Cities Mission was launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on June 25, 2015.
 
• The goal is to promote sustainable and inclusive cities that provide core infrastructure, a clean and sustainable environment, and give a decent quality of life to their citizens.
 
• The mission focuses on sustainable and inclusive development by creating replicable models which act like lighthouses to other aspiring cities.
 
• The mission is operated as a centrally sponsored scheme and the central government has allocated Rs. 48,000 crore for the development of 100 smart cities.
 
 
 
• **Key Features of Smart Cities**
 
 
• **Smart Mobility:** Efficient and sustainable transport system, smart traffic management, and public transportation.
 
• **Smart Environment:** Sustainable waste management, pollution control, and green spaces.
 
• **Smart Governance:** E-governance, citizen participation, and digital services.
 
• **Smart Economy:** Digital economy, innovation hubs, and entrepreneurship support.
 
• **Smart Living:** High quality of life, health, education, and safety services.
 
 
 
• **Implementation Strategy**
 
 
• The strategy involves area-based development and city-wide smart solutions.
 
• Area-based development includes retrofitting, redevelopment, and greenfield development.
 
• City-wide smart solutions involve the application of smart solutions to existing city-wide infrastructure.
 
• The implementation of the mission is through Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs) created for each city.
